liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (3 reviews): Reviewer loves the opening run of Half-Step into Franklin's Tower into Feel Like A Stranger; The uploaded Half-Step track cuts off before the song's final seconds, leaving no proper ending [16][23][24]
- **Billy for President Rap** (2 other sources): Bob endorses Bill for president after the opening Mississippi Half-Step [2][13]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Reviewer also singles out the Scarlet Begonias into Fire on the Mountain pairing [16]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): Reviewer finds Jerry's singing of Ship of Fools heartfelt and excellent [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Billy for President Rap**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-05-04.aud.glassberg.motb-0037.96584.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 168 min; rated 4.27/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the sound of this audience recording fantastic [17]
- **gd1980-05-04.163761.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 169 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd80-05-04.naks.munder.11768.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 164 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the audience recording's sound quality holds the show back from a higher rating [14]
- **gd1980-05-04.nak700.glassberg.motb.fix-96584.96910.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 170 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this a pretty good audience recording [24]
- **gd1980-05-04.aud.morris.106081.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 157 min [10]
- **gd1980-05-04.178812.shure.sm57.Renninger.Carbonetta.Visser.flac2448**: source not stated; 19 songs; 151 min [13]

## Around the show

- Reviewer was very intoxicated at the show; their next Dead show was Radio City Music Hall that fall [16]
- Reviewer attended at the end of senior year of high school, standing on the floor in the tenth row [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-05-04.aud.glassberg.motb-0037.96584.flac16**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Adam Egert and Derek McCabe; source: 2 x Nakamichi CM700 => Sony TC-D5M >> MAC [1]
- **gd1980-05-04.163761.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5 [2]. Also: Wagner and Barry Glassberg taped Spring 1980 together, each with one Nakamichi 700 mic and a D5 deck, mics paired [2]
- **gd80-05-04.naks.munder.11768.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak 300's [3]
- **gd1980-05-04.nak700.glassberg.motb.fix-96584.96910.flac16**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Adam Egert and Derek McCabe; source: 2 x Nakamichi CM700 => Sony TC-D5M >> MAC [6]. Also: Reviewer believes this is the corrected version of the earlier Glassberg source with the truncated opener [24]
- **gd1980-05-04.aud.morris.106081.flac16**: taped by Bob Morris; transferred by Bob Morris; source: Nakamichi shotgun x2 (CM-300?) > Cassette Master [10]. Also: The encore was captured with Charlie Connor's Sony ECM-990 stereo microphone [10]
- **gd1980-05-04.178812.shure.sm57.Renninger.Carbonetta.Visser.flac2448**: taped by Kenn Renninger; transferred by Nick Carbonetta, Eric Visser; source: Shure SM57 > Marantz Superscope [13]. Also: Shure SM57 cassette source from Kenn Renninger's collection, shared through his wife Peg [13]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1980-05-04 Sun Baltimore Civic Center, Baltimore, MD](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1370489721556/grateful-dead-1980-05-04-sun-baltimore) [27]
